content:
Focus: tone/de-hype program (#287) + completed RFC-1 M0.

LANDED on main this session:
- M0 spikes merged — SPIKE-1 SubstKit toy (PR #3; carrier verdict: plain de Bruijn stays core-Lean-only, Fintype NOT needed; Q-KIT resolved), SPIKE-2 normalizer probe (PR #4; hit rate 100%, Q-TV2 resolved → semantic TV as thin fallback).
- CI: caching + PR-run cancellation + fail-fast (#5), then cargo-nextest 4-shard (#7) — ~20min → ~6min.
- De-hype: public docs README/RATIONALE/thermite-design + tone standard (#9); root .design thermite-2 docs + standard's "Avoid the tics" (#10); external docs/ scaffold — index/overview/language/verification/trust (#11).
- Infra recovered: crosslink hub reset to origin + history re-imported as #282-286; SSH commit-signing configured (futura key registered as a signing key).

OPEN: PR #12 — bakes tone-and-voice into the build workflow (goal.md R-TONE-1 + acto-doc-author/acto-builder refs) and adds .design/tone-comment-pass-plan.md. Merge when CI green.

NEXT (big, gated base): deep all-crate SOURCE-COMMENT tone pass. Spec = .design/tone-comment-pass-plan.md (self-contained) + .design/tone-and-voice.md. Launch as a single background kickoff (comments-only, NO semantics/identifiers/status-labels/schema; self-verify per crate: git diff comment-only + cargo test -p <crate> green + lean lake build unaffected; commit per crate; crate order in plan). This PR is the rebase base — land before stacking code work; steer parallel work to non-overlapping files. A ready kickoff prompt+command was handed to the user.

PARKED / conventions:
- docs/ polish (rationale.md .design-decouple + README trim) — deferred per owner.
- .design SUBDIR docs = historical artifacts, OUT of scope for tone.
- .crosslink/hook-config.json = intentional uncommitted LOCAL variant; NEVER commit (maintainer taste).
- CHANGELOG = discretion (crosslink post-op churn).

RFC-1 program: M0 complete; stage-1 forge tier (.design/stage1-forge-tier.md, final) is the next feature work, gated behind the comment pass. Stage-2/3 docs PROVISIONAL — their spike inputs are now satisfied, so a /design re-pass can finalize them.
